x: The meeting also saw the pole vault debut in club colours of Henry Pfenninger. He cleared 12 feet at the first attempt, despite admitting to being off-colour, although he failed 12 feet 6 inches.

A notable exception was Henry Pfenninger who won the pole vault with some ease and took the Belgrave record up some 2 feet with him. He cleared 13 ft. 9 ins. and only narrowly infringed the bar at 14 ft. 1 in.

The 400m. hurdles sees Mel Ford in 16th place, and Charlie Gillett in 43rd. Swiss member Henry Pfenninger is 12th in the pole vault. Derek Beesey has second place in the triple-jump, with Derek Glendinning in 39th.
